**Finding submitted: MISSING (insurance clause absent).**

- **Investigation:** Searched the full document for "insurance", the regex `insur|coverage|certificate|indemnif`, and "liability"; read the opening section (sec-p0001) and the entire General Provisions run (sec-5.4, covering Sections 5.4–10.8). No insurance obligation exists anywhere, and the only "liability" hits are the no-joint-venture language in 10.2.
- **Rule applies:** HDI designs, hosts, operates and maintains the Site on its own server (1.1, 1.3) and has access to our Content, user information and data (8.1) — a hosting vendor processing Customer Data, which is walk-away territory with no coverage at all.
- **Cure:** One insert of a new Section 10.9 after 10.8, at the preferred level, carrying exactly the six checklist elements (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber/privacy 5M reaching every category of data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). I omitted the model language's "at its own expense" and one-year tail as non-element extras, and noted the fallback (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) in the comment.
